integrity: The proof is definition-level and does not rely on numerical experiments or attainment of a supremum. The Corollary 2 contradiction uses only the published bound \(J_1(X)\le2/3\) and nonnegativity of \(\rho_X(1)\).
scientific_limitations: The identity is elementary once the definitions are aligned; novelty depends on the absence of the all-space equality in the inspected defining paper and checked literature. The finding does not audit other results in that paper.
title: The metric James constant is exactly a reparameterization of the James constant
